text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Active share trading on Bahrain Stock Exchange continues, around ten million shares were traded on Sunday.
- Overseas estate agency, DTZ Debenham Thorpe, to close Bahrain office by the end of 1996, moves operations to Jeddah.
- Bahrain and Germany to bolster commercial links, take steps to implement individual and joint economic programmes.
